title: SEC Financial Sections
scope: Retained MD&A and financial statements with notes; historical reporting years vary by filing. The corpus is not a collection of complete filings.
note: Corpus totals describe retained sections, not complete filings. Words, UTF-8 bytes and source tokens were measured read-only from the prepared Parquet on 2026-11-03. Chunk counts describe the shared baseline chunking; index configurations may vary by method.
word_count_definition: Whitespace-separated words in sections[].text; read-only streamed measurement on 2026-11-03.
